_readme: Indoor ground truth: corrections applied on top of the indoor maps from routing-scraper (data/indoor/*.json, contracts/indoor-map.schema.json) when they are loaded, so updates to those maps don't erase on-site findings. Remove an entry once the source map has it. Keys are the indoor map's building_id; `aliases` lists the same building's ids elsewhere (frontend, backend, GIS).

elevators.source: On-site check by the team, 2026-11-14: five cars in the same lobby, numbered 1-5, all serving every floor. Consistent with UMass SIN #813 ('State elevator inspection (#5)'). The ArcGIS layer and the routing-scraper map show a single marker for the lobby.

non_public_floors.3rd-floor: Staff offices; no student-facing destination. Elevators may still stop here.

elevators.source: Team believes the Student Union has one elevator. Not yet checked on site.

ilc-se.source: On-site check by the team, 2026-11-14: the door on North Pleasant St (you face west on entering, photo taken) opens straight onto floor 2, with an elevator immediately to the right. The ArcGIS east elevator is 2 m from this door.

entrance_floors._pending: A second door also opens straight onto floor 2 (you face southeast on entering). Not yet matched to an entrance: by facing direction it would be ilc-nw, but ilc-nw's ground is ~7 m lower than ilc-se and the frontend marks it as stepped; ilc-ne (same ground height as ilc-se) is the likelier match. Confirm before recording.
entrance_floors._note: The routing-scraper map puts its two ILC entrances (south, west) on floor 1; this list overrides by location.
